boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten Berkeley corridors, each anchored by a distinct named destination with a direct public source.

cards.title: Telegraph Avenue for Moe's Books
cards.subtitle: Telegraph Avenue — 2476 Telegraph Ave
cards.notes: Walk the Telegraph Avenue block to Moe's at 2476 Telegraph and browse its named bookstore location; confirm current store details before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A Telegraph Avenue stop centered on a long-running Berkeley bookstore.
cards.evidence_claim: Moe's Books identifies its current building as 2476 Telegraph Avenue in Berkeley.
cards.access_notes: Retail visit; check the bookstore directly for current hours and event details.

cards.title: Telegraph Avenue for Amoeba Music
cards.subtitle: Telegraph Avenue — 2455 Telegraph Ave
cards.notes: Use the Telegraph Avenue block as a record-shopping stop at Amoeba's Berkeley store, whose official location page lists daily 11 a.m.–7 p.m. hours.
cards.short_summary: A record-store reason to walk Telegraph Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Amoeba Music lists its Berkeley store at 2455 Telegraph Avenue and states it is open daily from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.
cards.source_title: Amoeba Music — Store Locations, Hours and General Information
cards.access_notes: Officially listed daily hours are 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.entity_name: Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive
cards.title: Center Street for BAMPFA
cards.subtitle: Center Street — 2155 Center St, between Oxford and Shattuck
cards.notes: Head to the Center Street entrance of BAMPFA and use the museum's direct directions page for transit and parking context before choosing a program or gallery visit.
cards.short_summary: An arts-and-film stop one block from Downtown Berkeley BART.
cards.evidence_claim: BAMPFA states that it is at 2155 Center Street between Oxford Street and Shattuck Avenue, one block from Downtown Berkeley BART.
cards.access_notes: Review BAMPFA's current visitor information and program availability before visiting.

cards.title: Addison Street for Berkeley Rep
cards.subtitle: Addison Street — 2025 Addison St
cards.notes: Plan an Addison Street theatre outing around Berkeley Rep's current calendar; its visitor page places the theatres and box office half a block from Downtown Berkeley BART.
cards.short_summary: A downtown performance corridor anchored by Berkeley Rep.
cards.evidence_claim: Berkeley Rep states that its theatres and box office are at 2025 Addison Street, half a block from Downtown Berkeley BART.
cards.source_title: Plan your visit | Berkeley Repertory Theatre
cards.access_notes: Tickets and performance times vary; consult the theatre's current schedule.

cards.title: Kittredge Street for Central Library
cards.subtitle: Kittredge Street — 2090 Kittredge St at Shattuck
cards.notes: Use Kittredge Street for a library stop at Central; the library's Commons page places it on the first floor at Kittredge and Shattuck.
cards.short_summary: A public-library anchor at the Kittredge–Shattuck corner.
cards.evidence_claim: Berkeley Public Library lists Central Library at 2090 Kittredge Street and locates The Commons at Kittredge and Shattuck on the first floor.
cards.source_title: Central Library The Commons | Berkeley Public Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library's current location page for open hours, services, and event access.

cards.entity_name: The UC Theatre Taube Family Music Hall
cards.title: University Avenue for The UC Theatre
cards.subtitle: University Avenue — 2036 University Ave
cards.notes: Check the UC Theatre's current program, then use its University Avenue address as the anchor for this downtown block and a documented local landmark.
cards.short_summary: A University Avenue music-hall stop in a designated city landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The UC Theatre states that it is at 2036 University Avenue and was designated a City of Berkeley landmark in 2002.
cards.source_title: History | The UC Theatre Taube Family Music Hall
cards.access_notes: Admission and age policies depend on the individual event; review the current event page.

cards.title: Durant Avenue for Berkeley City Club
cards.subtitle: Durant Avenue — 2315 Durant Ave
cards.notes: Walk Durant Avenue to see the Berkeley City Club's Julia Morgan-designed landmark exterior, then check directly with the club for any public access or event arrangements.
cards.short_summary: A Durant Avenue architectural landmark designed by Julia Morgan.
cards.evidence_claim: Berkeley City Club identifies itself as a 1930 landmark with design and décor by Julia Morgan and lists its address as 2315 Durant Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is straightforward; contact the club for access to interior spaces or events.

cards.title: College Avenue for Rialto Cinemas Elmwood
cards.subtitle: College Avenue — 2966 College Ave at Ashby
cards.notes: Use College Avenue at Ashby for a film plan at Rialto Cinemas Elmwood; buy tickets only after checking the currently scheduled films and posted showtimes.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue film-theatre destination at Ashby.
cards.evidence_claim: Rialto Cinemas lists Rialto Cinemas Elmwood at 2966 College Avenue at Ashby in Berkeley.
cards.source_title: Admission & Box Office — Rialto Cinemas Elmwood
cards.access_notes: Box office opening and closing follow the day's first and last showtimes; review the official schedule.

cards.title: Euclid Avenue for Berkeley Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Euclid Avenue — 1201 Euclid Ave
cards.notes: Take Euclid Avenue to the terraced Berkeley Rose Garden and follow park rules; the City lists the garden's pergola, picnic area, restroom, and accessible features.
cards.short_summary: A Euclid Avenue park with terraced rose beds and a pergola.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Berkeley lists Berkeley Rose Garden Park at 1201 Euclid Avenue, with 1,500 rose bushes, 250 varieties, a pergola, picnic area, restroom, and accessible features.
cards.source_title: Berkeley Rose Garden Park | City of Berkeley
cards.access_notes: City-listed park hours are 6 a.m.–10 p.m. unless otherwise indicated.

cards.title: Indian Rock Avenue for Indian Rock Park
cards.subtitle: Indian Rock Avenue — 950 Indian Rock Ave
cards.notes: Use Indian Rock Avenue to reach this City-listed rock park; stay on designated areas and choose its walking trails, picnic area, or overlook rather than unsupervised climbing.
cards.short_summary: A North Berkeley rock park split across Indian Rock Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Berkeley states that Indian Rock Park is at 950 Indian Rock Avenue, is split across both sides of the avenue, and includes walking trails, a picnic area, and a vista/overlook.
cards.source_title: Indian Rock Park | City of Berkeley
cards.access_notes: City-listed park hours are 6 a.m.–10 p.m. unless otherwise indicated; follow posted park rules.
